verdict.rationale: Gumloop's docs describe a Connectors page for adding integrations like Gmail, Salesforce, and Slack, plus dedicated Slack/Teams/email agent channels, showing some prebuilt, vendor-style integrations. However, there is no evidence of the scale implied by 'thousands of apps' or of Gumloop maintaining a large vendor-curated integration catalog — most extensibility beyond a handful of named connectors relies on generic MCP server connections rather than prebuilt vendor-maintained apps. Missing for 10: evidence of a large (hundreds/thousands) integration marketplace, vendor-maintained status claims, and independent corroboration of connector breadth.
